create_external_document_loader: create an ExternalDocumentLoader instance with file_path, url, and api_key to load documents from an external endpoint
load_external_document: load a document by reading a local file and sending it via PUT to an external /process endpoint
build_document_with_metadata: build LangChain Document objects from JSON response containing page_content and metadata fields
configure_auth_headers: configure Authorization Bearer and X-Filename headers when initializing the external document loader
handle_document_response: handle dict or list JSON responses from the external endpoint and convert them to LangChain Document objects
